history.name: Two patients in one slot
history.symptoms: Two patients who booked the same 10:30 slot within the same second both got a confirmation, and the doctor had a double booking.
history.fix_summary: Added a unique constraint on doctor and slot, and offered the second patient the next free slot.

history.name: Walk-in patients crash the patient list
history.symptoms: The patient list crashed with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip' whenever a walk-in patient had no phone number.
history.fix_summary: Treated a missing phone number as an empty string before formatting it.

history.name: Month view without its last day
history.symptoms: The month view of the doctor's calendar never showed the last day of the month, so appointments on the 30th or 31st were invisible.
history.fix_summary: Looped up to and including the last day instead of stopping one day early.

history.name: Reminders an hour early after the clock change
history.symptoms: After the clocks went forward in March, appointment reminder SMSes arrived an hour early, because reminder times were saved as local times without a timezone.
history.fix_summary: Saved reminder times in UTC together with the clinic's timezone and converted them when sending.

history.name: Devanagari names as boxes on receipts
history.symptoms: Patient names written in Devanagari printed as empty boxes on PDF receipts.
history.fix_summary: Embedded a Unicode font in the PDF and passed the names through as UTF-8.

history.name: Receipt a paisa off from the payment
history.symptoms: Consultation fees with GST were calculated as floats, so some receipts showed ₹1,180.01 while the card was charged ₹1,180.00.
history.fix_summary: Calculated fees in whole paise and rounded once with Decimal.

new_report.title: Appointment reminders an hour early again after the clock change
new_report.description: Since the clocks went forward on Sunday, reminder SMSes for our London clinics arrive an hour early: a patient booked at 9:00 gets the 8:00 reminder at 7:00. Reminder times saved since Friday's deploy are stored as local times without a timezone.

key_clue: Reminder times saved since Friday's deploy are stored as local times without a timezone
why: Same symptom (reminders an hour early after the clock change), same component, and the same cause in the same code: the reminders code saving times without a timezone, which #226 fixed.

history.name: Rider app crash before the first GPS fix
history.symptoms: The rider app crashed with a NullPointerException when a rider accepted an order before the phone had found its location.
history.fix_summary: Waited for the first location before drawing the route.

history.name: Two orders from one double tap
history.symptoms: Tapping Place Order twice quickly created two orders and charged the customer twice.
history.fix_summary: Sent an idempotency key with each order and disabled the button while it was submitting.

history.name: Old menu prices after a restaurant update
history.symptoms: When a restaurant changed its prices, customers kept seeing the old prices for up to an hour.
history.fix_summary: Purged the menu cache whenever a restaurant saves its menu.

history.name: Coupons that died at 5:30 AM
history.symptoms: Coupons valid until 31 March stopped working at 5:30 AM on 31 March, because the expiry was stored as midnight UTC.
history.fix_summary: Stored each coupon's expiry as the end of the day in India's timezone.

history.name: Emoji turned delivery notes into ????
history.symptoms: Delivery instructions with emoji were saved as ???? and a few orders failed to save at all.
history.fix_summary: Moved the orders table to utf8mb4.

history.name: Earnings screen that never stops loading
history.symptoms: The rider earnings screen kept requesting the next page forever when the last page came back empty.
history.fix_summary: Stopped paging when a page comes back empty.

history.name: The ₹249.30000000000004 cart
history.symptoms: Cart totals with a percentage discount showed long decimals like ₹249.30000000000004, and the payment gateway rejected the amount.
history.fix_summary: Kept all money as whole paise in integers and formatted it only for display.

new_report.title: Cart total showing long decimals again (₹399.90000000000003)
new_report.description: Since Tuesday's release, carts with a percentage discount show totals like ₹399.90000000000003 and the payment gateway rejects the amount. The cart total is being computed on rupee floats instead of whole paise.

key_clue: The cart total is being computed on rupee floats instead of whole paise
why: Same long-decimal totals on carts with a percentage discount, rejected by the payment gateway: the cart total is computed in rupee floats again, the exact path #329 fixed.

history.name: Deadlines shown in UTC
history.symptoms: Homework deadlines of 11:59 PM showed as 6:29 PM, because the page displayed the UTC time.
history.fix_summary: Displayed deadlines in the school's timezone.

history.name: <<<<<<< HEAD on the timetable
history.symptoms: The timetable page went live with '<<<<<<< HEAD' and '>>>>>>> exams-week' printed above the table, and both versions of Friday's periods.
history.fix_summary: Resolved the conflict and added a CI step that fails the build on conflict markers.

history.name: Class average is NaN
history.symptoms: The class average showed NaN whenever any student had an ungraded assignment with a null mark.
history.fix_summary: Left ungraded work out of the average.

history.name: Big uploads vanish with a green tick
history.symptoms: Homework PDFs over 10 MB showed a green tick but never arrived, because the production proxy had a 10 MB body limit that the local setup didn't.
history.fix_summary: Raised the proxy limit to 50 MB, added it to the local setup, and showed an error for bigger files.

history.name: Login redirect loop
history.symptoms: Students with an expired session bounced between /login and /dashboard forever.
history.fix_summary: Cleared the expired session cookie before redirecting to login.

new_report.title: Merge conflict markers on the timetable page
new_report.description: After this morning's deploy the timetable page shows '<<<<<<< HEAD', '=======' and '>>>>>>> sports-day' above the table, with two versions of Friday's periods. Two branches edited the timetable at once and the conflict was committed. The CI run for that deploy shows the conflict-marker step was skipped.

key_clue: The CI run for that deploy shows the conflict-marker step was skipped
why: Same conflict markers shipped on the same timetable page because the CI conflict-marker step added by #406's fix was skipped, so that fix stopped working.

history.name: Shares that don't add up to the bill
history.symptoms: Splitting ₹1,000 three ways gave everyone ₹333.33, and ₹0.01 went missing from the group total.
history.fix_summary: Stored shares in whole paise and gave the leftover paise to the first person.

history.name: Every reminder email sent twice
history.symptoms: Two reminder workers picked up the same job, so people got every 'you owe' reminder email twice.
history.fix_summary: Locked each reminder job while a worker sends it.

history.name: Accented names garbled in emails
history.symptoms: People with accents in their names saw them garbled in emails, like 'JosÃ©' or 'MÃ¼ller', because the email body was encoded as Latin-1.
history.fix_summary: Encoded all outgoing emails as UTF-8.

history.name: Crash creating a group without a photo
history.symptoms: Creating a group without a photo crashed the iOS app, because the code force-unwrapped the optional image.
history.fix_summary: Used a default group image when none is chosen.

history.name: Monthly summary skips the last day
history.symptoms: The monthly spending summary left out expenses added on the last day of the month.
history.fix_summary: Included the last day in the date range.

history.name: Currency rates a day old
history.symptoms: Expenses in euros were converted with yesterday's rate, because the rate cache only expired at midnight UTC.
history.fix_summary: Expired cached rates every hour.

new_report.title: My name looks broken in the message you sent
new_report.description: Hi! This morning I got the 'you owe Aarav' message in my inbox and it greets me as 'RenÃ©' instead of René. My friend Zoë says hers greets her as 'ZoÃ«'. Inside the app our names look fine, and these messages used to show them correctly.

key_clue: it greets me as 'RenÃ©' instead of René
why: Accented names turned into 'Ã©'-style characters only in the emailed message is the Latin-1 email encoding bug (#509) coming back; the duplicate-email bug (#505) is in the same component but has a different symptom.

history.name: Audio stops when the screen locks
history.symptoms: Guided audio stopped a few seconds after the screen locked, because playback ran in the activity instead of a foreground service.
history.fix_summary: Moved playback to a foreground service.

history.name: Paywall shows ₹0.00
history.symptoms: The paywall showed ₹0.00 and crashed on tap when the store price hadn't loaded yet.
history.fix_summary: Showed a loading state until the store price arrives.

history.name: Downloads stuck at 99%
history.symptoms: Offline course downloads stuck at 99%, because the last chunk was never marked as finished.
history.fix_summary: Marked the final chunk as finished when its last byte arrives.

history.name: Japanese course titles as mojibake
history.symptoms: Japanese course titles showed as 'ç‘æƒ³' on Android, because the catalog API sent Shift_JIS text labelled as UTF-8.
history.fix_summary: Stored and served all catalog text as UTF-8.

history.name: Streaks reset by the clock change
history.symptoms: After daylight saving ended, the streak counter used a fixed UTC offset to decide which day a session belonged to, so late-evening sessions counted for the wrong day and streaks reset to 1.
history.fix_summary: Worked out each session's day from the user's timezone rules instead of a stored offset.

history.name: Streak gone after reinstalling
history.symptoms: Streaks showed 0 after reinstalling the app or switching phones, because they were only stored on the device.
history.fix_summary: Synced streaks to the server and restored them at sign-in.

history.name: Double minutes in the year in review
history.symptoms: Total minutes in the year in review were sometimes doubled, because two sync requests from the same phone saved the same session at once.
history.fix_summary: Made session uploads idempotent with a session ID.

new_report.title: My 212-night run went back to 1 for no reason
new_report.description: I meditate every night at about 11:15 before bed and had 212 nights in a row. On the first weekend after summer time finished here in Germany, the app said I had missed Saturday and my run went back to 1. Saturday's meditation is right there in my history, just listed under Sunday. Please give me my nights back!

key_clue: Saturday's meditation is right there in my history, just listed under Sunday
why: A late-evening session filed under the next day, on the weekend daylight saving ended, resetting the run to 1, is #618's fixed-offset timezone bug; #621 (streak gone after reinstalling) showed 0, not a one-day slip.

history.name: Event dates a day early in Australia
history.symptoms: Events listed for 8 PM showed the previous day for buyers in Australia, because dates were formatted in the server's timezone.
history.fix_summary: Formatted event dates in the venue's timezone.

history.name: Seat map shows sold seats as free
history.symptoms: The seat map showed seats as free for up to five minutes after they sold; buyers who picked them got a 'seat no longer available' error at payment.
history.fix_summary: Pushed seat changes to the map live instead of caching it.

history.name: Ticket PDFs without a QR code
history.symptoms: Ticket PDFs for guest checkouts had a blank square instead of the QR code, because the code generator was given a null account email.
history.fix_summary: Generated the QR code from the order ID instead of the email.

history.name: Same seat sold twice
history.symptoms: Two buyers who picked the same seat a moment apart were both charged and both received a ticket for it, because the availability check and the reservation were separate queries.
history.fix_summary: Reserved the seat with a single conditional update and refunded the second buyer automatically.

history.name: Partial refunds a paisa short
history.symptoms: Partial refunds were a paisa short on some orders, because the refund was computed with doubles.
history.fix_summary: Computed refunds in whole paise with BigDecimal.

history.name: Waitlist emails one person too many
history.symptoms: When 100 returned seats were released, 101 people on the waitlist got the 'your turn' email and the last one found nothing left.
history.fix_summary: Used < instead of <= when picking people from the waitlist.

new_report.title: Another family had our exact places at the show
new_report.description: We got to the Saturday show and an usher found another family already in row F, numbers 11 to 14. The passes on their phones showed the identical row and numbers as ours. The usher said two other groups had this problem tonight. We bought the second sales opened, and so did they. We had to stand at the back.

key_clue: The passes on their phones showed the identical row and numbers as ours
why: Two parties holding valid passes for identical places, both bought the instant sales opened, is #713's double-sale race condition; the cache bug (#705) only caused an error at payment, never two tickets.

history.name: Leave approved twice
history.symptoms: Two managers approving the same leave request at once took the days off the employee's balance twice.
history.fix_summary: Approved leave in one transaction that checks the request's status first.

history.name: Tamil names as boxes on payslips
history.symptoms: Employee names written in Tamil printed as empty boxes on payslip PDFs.
history.fix_summary: Embedded a Unicode font that covers Tamil.

history.name: Night shifts with negative hours
history.symptoms: Night shifts that crossed midnight were counted as negative hours, because only the time of day was subtracted.
history.fix_summary: Subtracted full date-times instead of times of day.

history.name: Manager dashboard crash for new teams
history.symptoms: The manager dashboard crashed for teams with no members yet, because the code read the first member's name without checking.
history.fix_summary: Showed an empty state for teams without members.

history.name: Last year's tax slabs after the budget
history.symptoms: After the new tax slabs went live on 1 April, TDS was still calculated with last year's slabs until the server restarted.
history.fix_summary: Reloaded tax slabs from the database at the start of each payroll run.

history.name: Bonus import stops at 1,000 rows
history.symptoms: Bonus spreadsheets with more than 1,000 rows were imported only up to row 1,000, with no error, because of the default page size.
history.fix_summary: Read the file in pages until the end and showed the row count after import.

history.name: Net salary a rupee short
history.symptoms: Net salary on payslips was sometimes ₹1 lower than the bank transfer, because deductions were calculated with doubles and rounded separately.
history.fix_summary: Calculated pay with BigDecimal and rounded once at the end.

history.name: Payslips broken by a library update
history.symptoms: A fresh build pulled a new major version of the PDF library and payslip generation failed with NoSuchMethodError.
history.fix_summary: Pinned the PDF library version and added a payslip test to CI.

new_report.title: Net salary on payslips lower than the bank transfer
new_report.description: Payslips are showing a net salary lower than the bank transfer again, this time for 14 employees, all in the Pune office. The difference is exactly one day's pay for each of them. All 14 joined on the 1st of the month, and their payslips count 29 working days instead of 30, as if counting starts on the 2nd.

key_clue: their payslips count 29 working days instead of 30, as if counting starts on the 2nd
why: Shares many words with #823, but the gap is exactly one day's pay from a working-days count that skips the joining day: a counting bug, not floating point rounding.

history.name: Hotel price goes up at checkout
history.symptoms: The hotel price on the results page was sometimes lower than at checkout, because search results were cached for an hour.
history.fix_summary: Re-checked prices before showing results older than five minutes.

history.name: Two bookings for one payment
history.symptoms: A slow payment callback and a user retry both confirmed the booking, so travellers got two booking numbers for one payment.
history.fix_summary: Confirmed bookings with an idempotency key from the payment.

history.name: Flight times an hour off after daylight saving
history.symptoms: After daylight saving started, departure times in itinerary emails were an hour off, because flight times were converted with a fixed UTC offset.
history.fix_summary: Converted flight times with each airport's timezone rules.

history.name: Passenger names cut at 20 letters
history.symptoms: Long passenger names were cut to 20 letters on tickets, and the airline rejected them at check-in.
history.fix_summary: Widened the name column to the airline's 57-letter limit.

history.name: Visa page crashes for unlisted countries
history.symptoms: The visa information page crashed when a passport country wasn't in the visa table.
history.fix_summary: Showed 'check with the embassy' when the country isn't listed.

history.name: Baggage fees in dollars for Indian users
history.symptoms: Baggage fees showed in USD for users in India, because the currency fell back to the default setting.
history.fix_summary: Picked the currency from the user's country, with INR as the default for India.

new_report.title: Flight departure times wrong in itinerary emails
new_report.description: Itinerary emails used to show the right times. Since Monday's release, itinerary emails for round-trip bookings show the wrong departure time for the outbound flight: it is always the return flight's departure time, usually days apart. The website shows the right times. The new email template seems to read the return leg for both flights.

key_clue: it is always the return flight's departure time, usually days apart
why: Shares many words with #911, but the outbound flight shows the return flight's time because the template reads the wrong leg, not a one-hour daylight saving shift.

history.name: Messages out of order on slow networks
history.symptoms: On slow networks, messages sent quickly one after another arrived in the wrong order, because each was sent on its own connection.
history.fix_summary: Numbered messages per chat and sorted them by number.

history.name: Typing indicator stuck on
history.symptoms: The 'typing…' indicator stayed on forever when the other person lost their connection mid-message.
history.fix_summary: Expired typing status after five seconds without an update.

history.name: Hindi push notifications as ????
history.symptoms: Push notifications for Hindi messages showed ???? because the payload was converted to ASCII.
history.fix_summary: Sent push payloads as UTF-8.

history.name: Chat export misses the newest message
history.symptoms: Exported chats always left out the newest message.
history.fix_summary: Included the last index in the export loop.

history.name: Crash opening a chat with a deleted user
history.symptoms: Opening a conversation with someone who had deleted their account crashed the iOS app, because the missing profile was force-unwrapped.
history.fix_summary: Showed 'Deleted user' when the profile is missing.

history.name: 'Seen at' times hours off abroad
history.symptoms: 'Seen at' times were hours off for people in other countries, because the server sent local times without an offset.
history.fix_summary: Sent all times in UTC and formatted them on the phone.

history.name: Battery drain from the reconnect loop
history.symptoms: With no network, the app tried to reconnect hundreds of times a second and drained the battery.
history.fix_summary: Added exponential backoff between reconnect attempts.

new_report.title: iOS app crashes when opening a chat
new_report.description: Since version 4.2, opening any conversation that contains a long video (40 MB or more) crashes the iOS app a few seconds after it opens. In Xcode, memory climbs past 1.5 GB right before the crash, because the app loads the whole video into memory to make its thumbnail. Chats without big videos open fine.

key_clue: the app loads the whole video into memory to make its thumbnail
why: Shares many words with #1017 (crash opening a chat), but the cause is running out of memory while loading a whole video, not a missing profile.

history.name: Stock count goes negative
history.symptoms: Two pickers scanning the last unit at the same time both succeeded, and the stock count went to -1.
history.fix_summary: Decremented stock with a conditional update that refuses to go below zero.

history.name: Barcode labels with ? instead of ü
history.symptoms: Product names with umlauts printed as '?' on barcode labels.
history.fix_summary: Sent label text to the printer as UTF-8 with the matching code page.

history.name: Stock CSV drops the last product
history.symptoms: The nightly stock CSV left out the last product in every warehouse.
history.fix_summary: Fixed the loop bound to include the last product.

history.name: Same-day cutoff an hour late in summer
history.symptoms: During summer time, orders placed until 3 PM were promised same-day shipping, although the real cutoff was 2 PM.
history.fix_summary: Checked the cutoff with the warehouse's timezone rules.

history.name: Crash on products without a supplier
history.symptoms: Generating purchase orders panicked with 'nil pointer dereference' for products that had no supplier.
history.fix_summary: Skipped products without a supplier and listed them for review.

history.name: Pallet weights off by a few grams
history.symptoms: Pallet weight totals were off by a few grams, so the scales flagged correct pallets as wrong.
history.fix_summary: Stored weights in whole grams.

new_report.title: Low-stock badge unreadable in dark mode
new_report.description: In dark mode, the red 'Low stock' badge on the dashboard is dark red text on a dark red background, so nobody can read it. It used to be readable before last week's colour update. Light mode is fine. The badge's colours are hard-coded instead of using the theme's colour variables.

key_clue: The badge's colours are hard-coded instead of using the theme's colour variables
why: A dark-mode colour problem in the dashboard's CSS; nothing in the history is about styling or the dashboard.

history.name: Due dates a day early
history.symptoms: Books borrowed late in the evening got a due date one day early, because due dates were calculated in UTC.
history.fix_summary: Calculated due dates in the library's timezone.

history.name: Two members reserve the last copy
history.symptoms: Two members reserving the last copy of a book at the same moment were both told it was theirs.
history.fix_summary: Locked the copy's row while reserving it.

history.name: Late fees with fifteen decimal places
history.symptoms: Late fees showed as ₹4.999999999999999 on receipts.
history.fix_summary: Stored fines in whole paise.

history.name: Page 2 of search repeats a book
history.symptoms: The second page of search results started with the last book from the first page.
history.fix_summary: Started each page at page × size instead of page × size − 1.

history.name: Overdue notices crash on members without email
history.symptoms: Sending overdue notices crashed with NoMethodError: undefined method 'downcase' for nil for members who signed up without an email address.
history.fix_summary: Sent paper notices to members without an email address.

new_report.title: Nightly catalogue import gets slower until it is killed
new_report.description: The nightly import of new books from the publisher feed takes longer every night (40 minutes last week, 3 hours last night), and the worker's memory keeps growing until the server kills it. Restarting the worker makes it fast again for a night or two. Every imported cover image is kept in an in-memory hash that is never cleared.

key_clue: Every imported cover image is kept in an in-memory hash that is never cleared
why: A memory leak in the import worker; no history bug involves memory or the import.

history.name: Daily highs on the wrong day
history.symptoms: Daily high temperatures were stored on the next day for stations east of UTC, because days were cut at midnight UTC.
history.fix_summary: Cut each station's days at its local midnight.

history.name: Humidity of 100.00000001%
history.symptoms: Saturated air was reported as 100.00000001% humidity and the server rejected the reading as invalid.
history.fix_summary: Clamped humidity to 0–100 and sent it as tenths of a percent.

history.name: Stations bricked by a power cut during updates
history.symptoms: Stations that lost power during a firmware update wouldn't boot, because the new image was written over the old one without a checksum.
history.fix_summary: Wrote updates to a second slot and switched only after the checksum passed.

history.name: Wind always from the north
history.symptoms: Stations with an unplugged wind vane reported 0° (north) instead of no reading, because a missing value was read as 0.
history.fix_summary: Reported missing readings as missing.

history.name: Station names garbled on the map
history.symptoms: Station names like 'Säntis' showed as 'SÃ¤ntis' on the public map.
history.fix_summary: Served the station list as UTF-8.

history.name: Readings saved twice after reconnecting
history.symptoms: When a station reconnected, it re-sent its buffer while the server was still saving the first copy, so readings appeared twice.
history.fix_summary: Ignored readings with a timestamp the station had already sent.

history.name: Dashboard shows yesterday's weather
history.symptoms: The public dashboard showed readings up to a day old, because the CDN cached the API response.
history.fix_summary: Set a 60-second cache time on readings.

history.name: Battery flat in a week
history.symptoms: Stations without a GPS fix kept the radio on in a retry loop and drained the battery in a week instead of a year.
history.fix_summary: Gave up on GPS after two minutes and retried hourly.

new_report.title: Rain gauge total drops to zero in very wet months
new_report.description: At three of our stations in Meghalaya, the monthly rain total suddenly dropped to 0 partway through July and started counting up from zero. Each time, the gauge had just passed 65,535 bucket tips. The firmware stores the tip count in a 16-bit unsigned integer.

key_clue: The firmware stores the tip count in a 16-bit unsigned integer
why: A 16-bit tip counter overflowing after 65,535; no history bug involves an overflowing counter or the rain gauge.

history.name: Prescription photos arrive sideways
history.symptoms: Photos of paper prescriptions taken on iPhones arrived rotated 90°, and pharmacists rejected them as unreadable.
history.fix_summary: Applied the photo's orientation tag before uploading.

history.name: Same-day delivery offered after the Sunday cutoff
history.symptoms: On Sundays, same-day delivery was still offered after the 2 PM cutoff, because the cutoff table was indexed with Sunday as 7 while the date library returns 0.
history.fix_summary: Used the date library's weekday numbers everywhere in isCutoffPassed().

history.name: Dose reminders an hour late after the clock change
history.symptoms: After the clocks went back in October, Android dose reminders fired exactly one hour late, because alarms were scheduled with the UTC offset saved when the reminder was created.
history.fix_summary: Scheduled alarms from the user's zone rules in ReminderScheduler.reschedule().

history.name: Search can't find medicines with a hyphen
history.symptoms: Searching for 'co-amoxiclav' found nothing, because the search box stripped hyphens but the index kept them.
history.fix_summary: Normalised hyphens the same way in the index and in queries.

history.name: Card charged twice when the network drops
history.symptoms: If the connection dropped right after tapping Pay, the app retried the payment and the card was charged twice.
history.fix_summary: Sent one idempotency key per checkout attempt.

history.name: Dose reminders stop after the phone restarts
history.symptoms: After a phone restart, no dose reminders fired until the app was opened again, because Android clears alarms on reboot.
history.fix_summary: Re-registered all alarms in a boot receiver.

history.name: Sold-out medicines still orderable
history.symptoms: Medicines that had sold out kept showing 'In stock' for up to 30 minutes, and those orders were cancelled later.
history.fix_summary: Cleared the stock cache on every stock change.

history.name: Evening slots shown as full
history.symptoms: Evening delivery slots showed as full while vans were half empty, because cancelled orders still counted toward slot capacity.
history.fix_summary: Counted only active orders toward a slot's capacity.

history.name: Login codes never reach UAE numbers
history.symptoms: Login codes were never sent to +971 numbers, because the phone check only accepted 10-digit Indian numbers.
history.fix_summary: Validated numbers with a phone-number library for every supported country.

history.name: Delivery slot times in UTC on iOS
history.symptoms: The iOS app showed delivery slots 5½ hours early, like '12:30–2:30 PM' for a 6–8 PM slot, because slot times were shown in UTC.
history.fix_summary: Formatted slot times in the device's timezone.

history.name: Order updates in English for Hindi users
history.symptoms: People who chose Hindi still got order-status notifications in English, because the template ignored the language setting.
history.fix_summary: Picked the notification template from the user's language.

history.name: Crash on prescriptions without a doctor's name
history.symptoms: The iOS prescription screen crashed for uploads with no doctor's name, because the name was force-unwrapped.
history.fix_summary: Showed 'Doctor not given' when the name is missing.

history.name: Dose reminders fire twice after a restart
history.symptoms: On some phones every dose reminder fired twice after a restart, because the boot receiver and WorkManager both re-created the same alarms.
history.fix_summary: Gave each alarm a unique work name and kept the existing one if it was already scheduled.

history.name: Coupon discount a paisa off
history.symptoms: Orders with a percentage coupon sometimes showed ₹0.01 more on the bill than the card was charged.
history.fix_summary: Calculated discounts in whole paise.

new_report.title: Dose reminders firing twice again since 6.4.0
new_report.description: Since the 6.4.0 update, several Android users get every dose reminder twice, a few seconds apart. All of them restarted their phones after updating. From a Pixel 7's logcat: `WM-WorkerWrapper: Worker result SUCCESS for dose_reminder_0812` appears twice for the same alarm. Separately, the reminder sound is quieter on Samsung phones, but that's probably a different ticket.

key_clue: every dose reminder twice, a few seconds apart. All of them restarted their phones after updating
why: Every reminder firing twice after a restart is #2143 (boot receiver and WorkManager both re-creating alarms); siblings #2118 (reminders stop after a restart) and #2108 (an hour late) don't double anything.

history.name: Gate passes show the wrong hour
history.symptoms: Visitor gate passes showed times 5½ hours early, so guards turned visitors away, because pass times were printed in UTC.
history.fix_summary: Fixed format_local() in common/timefmt.py to convert to the society's timezone; every screen formats times through it.

history.name: Two maintenance bills on the 1st
history.symptoms: Some flats got two maintenance bills on the 1st of the month, because two scheduler instances generated bills at the same time.
history.fix_summary: Took a database lock per month before generating bills.

history.name: Notices crash the app on long PDFs
history.symptoms: Opening notice PDFs longer than 30 pages crashed the app on older phones.
history.fix_summary: Rendered PDF pages one at a time as they scroll into view.

history.name: Complaint photos silently dropped
history.symptoms: Complaints filed with photos on slow networks were saved without the photos, because the upload gave up after 10 seconds without telling anyone.
history.fix_summary: Retried photo uploads in the background and showed their progress.

history.name: Late fee on bills paid on the due date
history.symptoms: Residents who paid just before midnight on the due date were charged a late fee, because the late-fee job ran before the payment confirmation was saved.
history.fix_summary: Ran the late-fee job only after the day's payment confirmations are processed.

history.name: Clubhouse double-booked
history.symptoms: Two residents booking the clubhouse for the same evening at the same moment both got a confirmation.
history.fix_summary: Added a unique constraint on amenity and slot.

history.name: Maintenance bill shows ₹2,499.999
history.symptoms: Bills for flats with a parking add-on showed totals like ₹2,499.999, and the payment link rejected the amount.
history.fix_summary: Calculated every bill line in whole paise in billing/money.py.

history.name: Resident list shows tenants who moved out
history.symptoms: The resident list kept showing tenants for up to a day after they moved out, because the list was cached.
history.fix_summary: Cleared the resident cache whenever a tenant is removed.

history.name: Gate pass QR fails for Tamil names
history.symptoms: QR codes on gate passes for visitors with Tamil names couldn't be scanned by the guard app, because the QR text wasn't UTF-8.
history.fix_summary: Encoded QR payloads as UTF-8.

history.name: Expense report skips the last flat in each wing
history.symptoms: The monthly expense report left out the last flat of every wing.
history.fix_summary: Included the last flat in the loop over each wing.

history.name: OTP login loops back on Android 14
history.symptoms: After entering the OTP, Android 14 users were sent back to the login screen, because the login token was saved after the app had already moved on.
history.fix_summary: Saved the token before navigating.

history.name: Owners who rent out get every notice twice
history.symptoms: Owners who also rented out their flat got every notice twice, once as owner and once as resident.
history.fix_summary: Sent each notice once per person.

history.name: 1 April receipts numbered in the old financial year
history.symptoms: Payments made between midnight and 5:30 AM on 1 April got receipt numbers from the old financial year, because the year came from the UTC date.
history.fix_summary: Took the financial year from the society's local date.

history.name: Water bills show 0 litres for new flats
history.symptoms: Water bills for newly added flats showed 0 litres, because a missing first meter reading was treated as 0.
history.fix_summary: Billed new flats from their first real reading and flagged them for the manager.

new_report.title: April bills with three decimals, payment link fails
new_report.description: Several B-wing residents can't pay April maintenance. Every affected flat has an add-on line on its bill, parking or the new EV charging, and the bill total shows amounts like ₹3,149.999. The payment page says `PaymentLinkError: amount must have at most 2 decimals (got 3149.999)`. Unrelated: the logo on the bill PDF looks stretched.

key_clue: an add-on line on its bill, parking or the new EV charging, and the bill total shows amounts like ₹3,149.999
why: Three-decimal totals the payment link rejects, including on flats with a parking add-on (#2222's original case), mean the shared bill money code is broken again; the other billing bugs (#2204 two bills, #2215 late fee, #2246 zero litres) look different.

history.name: Exams open an hour late after the clock change
history.symptoms: After daylight saving started, scheduled exams opened an hour late for students in London, because start times were stored with a fixed UTC offset.
history.fix_summary: Stored start times in UTC and converted them with the exam centre's zone rules.

history.name: Last answer lost when time runs out
history.symptoms: When the timer hit zero, the answer typed in the last few seconds was lost, because auto-submit fired before the pending autosave request finished.
history.fix_summary: Made submitExam() wait for the pending autosave before submitting.

history.name: Webcam check shows a black box on Safari
history.symptoms: The webcam check before the exam showed a black box on Safari, so students couldn't start.
history.fix_summary: Added the playsinline attribute to the video element.

history.name: Percentages rounded down
history.symptoms: Percentages like 89.5 were shown as 89%, because the percentage was cast to an integer.
history.fix_summary: Rounded half up to one decimal place.

history.name: 'Saved' shown when autosave failed
history.symptoms: Students whose login expired mid-exam saw 'Saved' after every answer, but nothing was saved, because a 401 response was treated as success.
history.fix_summary: Showed 'Not saved: log in again' on any failed autosave.

history.name: Question diagrams missing on small phones
history.symptoms: Diagrams in questions didn't show on phones narrower than 380 px.
history.fix_summary: Let diagrams shrink to the screen width.

history.name: Skipped questions get negative marks
history.symptoms: Skipped questions lost 0.25 marks as if they were wrong, because 'no answer' and 'wrong answer' shared a status.
history.fix_summary: Gave skipped questions their own status worth 0 marks.

history.name: Two students get the same seat number
history.symptoms: Students who registered at the same moment were given the same exam-centre seat number.
history.fix_summary: Assigned seat numbers from a database sequence.

history.name: Long names cut off on certificates
history.symptoms: Names longer than 30 characters were cut off on certificates.
history.fix_summary: Shrank the font for long names instead of cutting them.

history.name: Results emailed before moderation
history.symptoms: Students got their results by email before the moderators had approved them.
history.fix_summary: Sent results emails only after moderation is approved.

history.name: Autosave floods the server
history.symptoms: Autosave sent a request on every keystroke, and the server slowed down during big exams.
history.fix_summary: Debounced autosave to once every 3 seconds.

history.name: Timer keeps running during an approved break
history.symptoms: For students with an approved toilet break, the exam timer kept counting down during the break.
history.fix_summary: Paused the timer while a break is active.

history.name: Login fails for emails with a plus sign
history.symptoms: Students with a '+' in their email address couldn't log in, because the plus was turned into a space.
history.fix_summary: Encoded email addresses properly in the login request.

history.name: Exam fee shown in USD to Indian students
history.symptoms: The exam fee page showed the price in USD to students in India, because the currency defaulted to the company's account.
history.fix_summary: Took the currency from the student's country.

new_report.title: Final answers missing after auto-submit
new_report.description: Three students in yesterday's 11:00 Chemistry exam say their last answer is missing from the submitted paper. All three were still typing when the timer hit zero. Server log for one of them: `10:59:59.120 POST /autosave started`, `10:59:59.410 POST /submit 200`, then `10:59:59.870 POST /autosave 200`. The invigilator thinks the exam closed early, but the timer on the projector looked right.

key_clue: `10:59:59.120 POST /autosave started`, `10:59:59.410 POST /submit 200`, then `10:59:59.870 POST /autosave 200`
why: The autosave started before the submit and finished after it, so submit didn't wait for the pending autosave and lost the last answer, which is #2304; siblings #2315 (failed autosave shown as saved), #2336 (autosave flooding the server) and #2325 (seat-number race) are other defects.

history.name: Results stuck on 'Processing' after an analyser restart
history.symptoms: Samples that were on the analyser when it restarted stayed on 'Processing' forever, because their results message was never re-sent.
history.fix_summary: Asked the analyser for missed results after every restart.

history.name: 'Report ready' text before the doctor signs
history.symptoms: Patients got 'Your report is ready' texts before the doctor had signed the report, and then found nothing to download.
history.fix_summary: Sent the text only after the report is signed.

history.name: Doctor portal shows the previous patient's results
history.symptoms: Switching patients quickly showed the previous patient's results for a moment, because the older request finished last.
history.fix_summary: Cancelled the previous request when switching patients.

history.name: Haemoglobin 10 times too high from the new analyser
history.symptoms: Haemoglobin showed as 135 g/dL instead of 13.5 for samples from the new analyser, because its g/L values were labelled g/dL.
history.fix_summary: Mapped the new analyser's units in AnalyserImport.MapUnits().

history.name: Appointments booked twice on a double click
history.symptoms: Double-clicking 'Book' created two appointments for the same slot.
history.fix_summary: Disabled the button while booking and rejected duplicate bookings on the server.

history.name: No reference ranges for children
history.symptoms: Results for patients under 12 showed no normal range, because ranges were only loaded for adults.
history.fix_summary: Loaded age-specific ranges for every analyte.

history.name: Glucose 18 times too high in the patient app
history.symptoms: The patient app showed a fasting glucose of 1,620 mg/dL instead of 90, because the unit conversion applied the mmol/L to mg/dL factor twice.
history.fix_summary: Fixed UnitConverter.Convert() in Lab.Common to apply each factor once; every screen and report converts through it.

history.name: GST added twice on lab bills
history.symptoms: Lab bills for home collection added GST twice: once on the test and again on the total.
history.fix_summary: Applied GST once, on the line items.

history.name: Arabic names reversed on PDF reports
history.symptoms: Patient names in Arabic printed with their letters in reverse order on PDF reports.
history.fix_summary: Set right-to-left text direction for Arabic names.

history.name: Login codes expire before they arrive
history.symptoms: Login codes expired after 60 seconds, but text messages often took 90 seconds to arrive.
history.fix_summary: Made codes valid for 5 minutes.

history.name: 'Collected at' times in UTC on PDF reports
history.symptoms: 'Collected at' times on PDF reports were 5½ hours early, because they were printed in UTC.
history.fix_summary: Printed times in the lab's timezone.

history.name: PDF reports leave out the last test
history.symptoms: PDF reports with more than 20 tests left out the last test, because the page-break loop stopped one row early.
history.fix_summary: Included the last row when splitting tests across pages.

history.name: Pending-results email every minute
history.symptoms: Doctors got the same 'results pending' email every minute, because the reminder job put itself back on the queue.
history.fix_summary: Scheduled the reminder once per day per doctor.

new_report.title: Last test missing from long PDF reports
new_report.description: Dr. Mehta's patient had a 24-test wellness panel. The PDF report ends at Vitamin D; TSH, test 24, isn't on it, though the portal lists all 24. A 12-test report from the same day is complete. The hospital logo also looks blurry on the PDF, which marketing has complained about.

key_clue: The PDF report ends at Vitamin D; TSH, test 24, isn't on it
why: A long PDF report missing exactly its last test, while short ones are complete, is #2539; its PDF siblings #2529 (reversed Arabic names) and #2536 (UTC times) don't drop tests.

history.name: Invoice numbers skip after a failed save
history.symptoms: Invoice numbers jumped, for example from INV-0041 to INV-0043, whenever saving an invoice failed validation, because the number was taken before saving.
history.fix_summary: Took the next number inside the same transaction as the save.

history.name: Overdue reminders for invoices paid on the due date
history.symptoms: Clients who paid on the due date still got a 'payment overdue' email, because the reminder job read the invoice status before the payment was recorded.
history.fix_summary: Ran overdue reminders an hour after the day's payments are recorded.

history.name: Recurring invoices created twice
history.symptoms: Some monthly recurring invoices were created twice, because two workers ran the recurring-invoice job at the same time.
history.fix_summary: Locked each recurring schedule while its invoice is generated.

history.name: USD invoices use the previous day's rate
history.symptoms: USD invoices dated the 1st used the exchange rate of the 31st for users in India, because the rate date was taken in UTC.
history.fix_summary: Took the rate date from the user's timezone.

history.name: Timesheet hours negative across midnight
history.symptoms: Timesheet entries from 10 PM to 2 AM counted as -20 hours.
history.fix_summary: Added a day to the end time when it is before the start time.

history.name: CSV export splits names with commas
history.symptoms: Client names with commas, like 'Rao, Iyer & Co', split into two columns in the CSV export.
history.fix_summary: Quoted every field in CSV exports.

history.name: USD invoices show ₹ on the PDF
history.symptoms: Invoices in US dollars showed the ₹ symbol on the PDF, because the symbol came from the freelancer's country.
history.fix_summary: Took the symbol from the invoice's currency.

history.name: GST on invoices to foreign clients
history.symptoms: Invoices to clients outside India showed 18% GST, because the tax rule only checked the freelancer's country.
history.fix_summary: Applied export rules when the client is outside India.

history.name: Exports time out for big accounts
history.symptoms: Exporting a year of invoices timed out after 30 seconds for accounts with more than 5,000 invoices.
history.fix_summary: Built big exports in the background and emailed a link.

history.name: Login links expire immediately
history.symptoms: Magic login links said 'expired' the moment they were opened, because the expiry was set to 0 minutes in production.
history.fix_summary: Set link expiry to 15 minutes and added a startup check.

history.name: Invoice total a paisa off with GST
history.symptoms: Invoices with line discounts and GST were a paisa off from the amount the client paid, because each line was rounded separately.
history.fix_summary: Rounded once, on the invoice total.

history.name: Client portal crashes on invoices without a logo
history.symptoms: The client portal crashed for invoices from freelancers who hadn't uploaded a logo.
history.fix_summary: Showed the freelancer's name when there is no logo.

history.name: Due date a day early for clients in the US
history.symptoms: Invoices due on 15 May showed '14 May' to clients in the US, because the client portal read the date as midnight UTC and showed it in local time.
history.fix_summary: Sent due dates as plain dates and formatted them without timezone conversion in formatDueDate().

history.name: Reminder emails in the wrong language
history.symptoms: Clients got reminder emails in the freelancer's language instead of their own.
history.fix_summary: Used the client's language for reminders.

new_report.title: Recurring invoices duplicated again this month
new_report.description: Four of my monthly retainers produced two identical invoices on 1 October, and two clients paid both. The job log shows `RecurringInvoiceJob start schedule=88 worker=2` and `RecurringInvoiceJob start schedule=88 worker=5` in the same second. Also the dashboard chart takes ages to load, not sure if that's related.

key_clue: `RecurringInvoiceJob start schedule=88 worker=2` and `RecurringInvoiceJob start schedule=88 worker=5` in the same second
why: Two workers running the recurring job for the same schedule at once is #2608; siblings #2601 (skipped numbers), #2604 (reminder race) and #2643 (due date) are different defects.

history.name: Heating starts an hour late after the clock change
history.symptoms: After the clocks went forward, heating schedules started an hour late, because the cloud sent schedules to the thermostat with last week's UTC offset.
history.fix_summary: Sent schedules in local time with the home's DST rules for the thermostat to apply.

history.name: Pairing fails silently on 5 GHz Wi-Fi
history.symptoms: Pairing failed with no message when the phone was on a 5 GHz network, because the thermostat only supports 2.4 GHz.
history.fix_summary: Detected 5 GHz networks and explained the problem.

history.name: Thermostat reads 2°C high
history.symptoms: Thermostats read about 2°C high after the screen had been on for a while, because heat from the screen reached the temperature sensor.
history.fix_summary: Subtracted a screen-heat offset based on brightness and how long the screen has been on.

history.name: Energy report shows a 25-hour day
history.symptoms: On the day the clocks went back, the energy report counted the repeated hour twice and showed 25 hours of heating.
history.fix_summary: Added up energy per UTC hour.

history.name: Firmware update stuck at 60%
history.symptoms: Firmware updates stopped at 60% on slow Wi-Fi, because the download timed out and never resumed.
history.fix_summary: Resumed downloads from the last good block.

history.name: App shows 'Offline' for working thermostats
history.symptoms: Reopening the app showed thermostats as 'Offline' for up to 5 minutes, because it displayed the last cached state first.
history.fix_summary: Asked for live status before showing the cached one.

history.name: Frost alerts all day for Celsius users
history.symptoms: Thermostats set to Celsius sent frost alerts all day, because the rule compared °C readings with a 41 °F threshold.
history.fix_summary: Converted readings to one unit before checking alert rules.

history.name: Schedule changes lost after a power cut
history.symptoms: Schedule changes made in the app were lost after a power cut, because the thermostat kept them in memory until midnight before saving.
history.fix_summary: Saved schedule changes to flash immediately.

history.name: Voice assistant sets °F on Celsius thermostats
history.symptoms: Asking the voice assistant for 'twenty-two degrees' set 22 °F on thermostats set to Celsius.
history.fix_summary: Sent the thermostat's own unit with every voice command.

history.name: Room sensors drain their batteries in weeks
history.symptoms: Wireless room sensors drained their batteries in weeks, because they retried sending forever when the thermostat was out of range.
history.fix_summary: Backed off retries up to once an hour.

history.name: Weekend schedule runs on Friday and Saturday
history.symptoms: The weekend schedule ran on Friday and Saturday instead of Saturday and Sunday, because the firmware counted days from 0 (Sunday) while the app counted from 1 (Monday).
history.fix_summary: Used ISO weekday numbers (Monday = 1) in the app and in schedule_apply() on the thermostat.

history.name: Away mode never turns off
history.symptoms: Away mode stayed on after people came home when the app's location access was set to 'While using'.
history.fix_summary: Asked for 'Always' location access and explained why.

history.name: Thermostat reboots on Wi-Fi passwords with emoji
history.symptoms: Thermostats rebooted in a loop when the Wi-Fi password contained an emoji, because the firmware read the password as ASCII.
history.fix_summary: Read Wi-Fi passwords as UTF-8.

new_report.title: Weekend heating program on the wrong days
new_report.description: Since firmware 4.8 my 'Weekend' program (21° from 9 AM) runs on Friday and Saturday, and Sunday morning is cold. The app shows the right days. Thermostat log: `schedule_apply: day=5 profile=weekend`. My wife thinks it's the clock change, but the times are right, only the days are wrong.

key_clue: runs on Friday and Saturday, and Sunday morning is cold
why: The weekend program shifted by a whole day, with the right times, is #2736's weekday-numbering bug; siblings #2701 (an hour late after the clock change) and #2725 (changes lost after a power cut) don't fit.

history.name: Prescription photos arrive sideways
history.symptoms: Photos of paper prescriptions taken on iPhones arrived rotated 90°, and pharmacists rejected them as unreadable.
history.fix_summary: Applied the photo's orientation tag before uploading.

history.name: Same-day delivery offered after the Sunday cutoff
history.symptoms: On Sundays, same-day delivery was still offered after the 2 PM cutoff, because the cutoff table was indexed with Sunday as 7 while the date library returns 0.
history.fix_summary: Used the date library's weekday numbers everywhere in isCutoffPassed().

history.name: Dose reminders an hour late after the clock change
history.symptoms: After the clocks went back in October, Android dose reminders fired exactly one hour late, because alarms were scheduled with the UTC offset saved when the reminder was created.
history.fix_summary: Scheduled alarms from the user's zone rules in ReminderScheduler.reschedule().

history.name: Search can't find medicines with a hyphen
history.symptoms: Searching for 'co-amoxiclav' found nothing, because the search box stripped hyphens but the index kept them.
history.fix_summary: Normalised hyphens the same way in the index and in queries.

history.name: Card charged twice when the network drops
history.symptoms: If the connection dropped right after tapping Pay, the app retried the payment and the card was charged twice.
history.fix_summary: Sent one idempotency key per checkout attempt.

history.name: Dose reminders stop after the phone restarts
history.symptoms: After a phone restart, no dose reminders fired until the app was opened again, because Android clears alarms on reboot.
history.fix_summary: Re-registered all alarms in a boot receiver.

history.name: Sold-out medicines still orderable
history.symptoms: Medicines that had sold out kept showing 'In stock' for up to 30 minutes, and those orders were cancelled later.
history.fix_summary: Cleared the stock cache on every stock change.

history.name: Evening slots shown as full
history.symptoms: Evening delivery slots showed as full while vans were half empty, because cancelled orders still counted toward slot capacity.
history.fix_summary: Counted only active orders toward a slot's capacity.

history.name: Login codes never reach UAE numbers
history.symptoms: Login codes were never sent to +971 numbers, because the phone check only accepted 10-digit Indian numbers.
history.fix_summary: Validated numbers with a phone-number library for every supported country.

history.name: Delivery slot times in UTC on iOS
history.symptoms: The iOS app showed delivery slots 5½ hours early, like '12:30–2:30 PM' for a 6–8 PM slot, because slot times were shown in UTC.
history.fix_summary: Formatted slot times in the device's timezone.

history.name: Order updates in English for Hindi users
history.symptoms: People who chose Hindi still got order-status notifications in English, because the template ignored the language setting.
history.fix_summary: Picked the notification template from the user's language.

history.name: Crash on prescriptions without a doctor's name
history.symptoms: The iOS prescription screen crashed for uploads with no doctor's name, because the name was force-unwrapped.
history.fix_summary: Showed 'Doctor not given' when the name is missing.

history.name: Dose reminders fire twice after a restart
history.symptoms: On some phones every dose reminder fired twice after a restart, because the boot receiver and WorkManager both re-created the same alarms.
history.fix_summary: Gave each alarm a unique work name and kept the existing one if it was already scheduled.

history.name: Coupon discount a paisa off
history.symptoms: Orders with a percentage coupon sometimes showed ₹0.01 more on the bill than the card was charged.
history.fix_summary: Calculated discounts in whole paise.

new_report.title: Paid for today, delivered tomorrow
new_report.description: Last Sunday at about 4:30 in the afternoon the app let me choose 'Today, 6–8 PM' for my father's insulin. I paid, and an hour later an SMS said it would come on Monday morning. On weekdays the app never shows 'Today' after lunch, so why did it on Sunday? Your support person blamed a courier shortage. Also, search is slow when I type medicine names.

key_clue: Last Sunday at about 4:30 in the afternoon the app let me choose 'Today, 6–8 PM'
why: Same-day delivery offered on a Sunday afternoon, when weekdays stop offering it after lunch, is #2104's Sunday cutoff bug; its siblings #2125 (slots shown as full) and #2132 (slot times in UTC) don't match.

new_report.title: Clubhouse booking confirmation shows the wrong time
new_report.description: I booked the clubhouse for my son's birthday, 7 to 10 PM on Saturday, and the confirmation says 1:30 PM to 4:30 PM. I tried again and got the same thing. Forwarded by the help desk, from the error log: `common/timefmt.py in format_local: 19:00 IST -> '13:30'`. It started after Tuesday's app update.

history.name: Wallet top-up charged twice
history.symptoms: Double-tapping 'Add ₹200' charged the rider's card twice but added ₹200 once.
history.fix_summary: Ignored a second top-up request with the same request ID.

history.name: Map shows bikes that were just taken
history.symptoms: The map kept showing bikes as available for up to 2 minutes after someone unlocked them.
history.fix_summary: Pushed unlock events to the map instead of caching bike positions.

history.name: Rides billed in whole hours
history.symptoms: A 61-minute ride was billed as 2 hours, because ride time was rounded up to whole hours instead of 15-minute blocks.
history.fix_summary: Billed rides in 15-minute blocks.

history.name: Passes bought on the 31st skip February
history.symptoms: Monthly passes bought on 31 January renewed in March, because renewal added a month without clamping to February's last day.

history.name: 'Ride ended' notification an hour late

history.name: Daily fare cap ignores rides after midnight

history.name: Pass expiry shown a day early

history.name: Card blocked when a family shares it

history.name: Top-up screen crashes when the UPI app returns early

history.name: Monthly statements only in English

history.fix_summary: Generated statements in the rider's language.

history.name: Refunds stuck on 'Processing'
history.symptoms: Refunds stayed on 'Processing' forever when the bank's confirmation arrived before the refund record was saved.
history.fix_summary: Saved the refund before calling the bank.

history.name: Peak fares on public holidays
history.symptoms: Public holidays were charged at peak fares in January, because the new year's holiday list hadn't been loaded.
history.fix_summary: Loaded holiday lists a year ahead and alerted when one is missing.

history.name: No transfer discount at exactly 60 minutes
history.symptoms: Transfers made exactly 60 minutes after the first tap didn't get the transfer discount, because the check used < 60 instead of <= 60.
history.fix_summary: Included the 60th minute in the transfer window.

new_report.title: Trips from last December filed under December 2026
new_report.description: Scrolling my journey history, there's a 'December 2026' section, which hasn't happened yet, holding three trips from 29, 30 and 31 December last year. The rest of last December is under 'December 2025' where it belongs. Maybe a timezone problem? Not urgent, just weird.

history.name: Room rates shown without GST on the booking page
history.symptoms: Guests outside India saw room rates without GST on the booking page, and the GST was only added at payment.
history.fix_summary: Showed GST-inclusive rates to every guest in rateLabel().

history.name: Channel sync drops the last room type
history.symptoms: Only the first N−1 room types reached the travel agencies, so suites were never sold there.

history.name: Booking total a rupee off on the confirmation page
history.symptoms: Totals on the booking confirmation page were sometimes ₹1 higher than the card charge, because the page rounded each night's rate before adding them up.

history.name: Check-in times shown in UTC in the staff app
history.symptoms: The front-desk app showed expected arrival times 5½ hours early, because they were shown in UTC.

history.name: Special requests missing from the housekeeping list

history.name: Two guests booked into the last room
history.symptoms: Two guests booking the last free room at the same moment both got a confirmation.
history.fix_summary: Reserved the room with a conditional update before taking payment.

history.name: Weekend rates applied on Thursdays
history.symptoms: Thursday nights were charged the weekend rate, because the rate calendar counted weekdays from Monday = 0 while rate plans used Sunday = 0.
history.fix_summary: Used ISO weekday numbers in RatePlan.rate_for().

history.name: Guest app crashes on bookings without a room number
history.symptoms: The iOS guest app crashed when opening a booking that had no room assigned yet.

history.name: Occupancy report puts early check-ins on the wrong day

history.name: Deposit a rupee off on the payment link

history.name: Booking page shows yesterday's rates

history.name: Special requests wiped when a booking's dates change

history.name: Rates sync twice after a restart
history.symptoms: After a restart, the channel manager pushed every rate twice, and some agencies kept the older one.

history.name: Hindi guest names garbled on registration cards

history.name: Staff app crashes on walk-ins without an email

history.name: Housekeeping rooms assigned to staff on leave

history.name: Loyalty points added twice for long stays

history.name: Invoice total a rupee off at checkout

history.name: Availability calendar a day off for guests in the US

history.name: Booking emails sent twice
history.symptoms: Guests got two confirmation emails when the payment callback arrived twice.

history.name: Goa invoices show the Mumbai address
history.symptoms: Invoices from the Goa property showed the Mumbai head office address.
history.fix_summary: Read the address from each property's settings.

history.name: Promo codes stack with member rates
history.symptoms: Guests could apply a promo code on top of the member rate and get two discounts.

new_report.title: Totals a rupee off again

But for room 412 the confirmation page and the card charge at booking match exactly at ₹14,832; it's the checkout invoice that says ₹14,833, and its GST is rounded line by line. history.name: KYC selfie check fails in low light

history.name: Stop-loss orders fire late at market open

history.name: Contract note brokerage a paisa off

history.name: Chart times in UTC for users abroad

history.name: Price alerts an hour late at market open
history.symptoms: Price alerts set overnight fired up to an hour after the price was hit at market open, because all overnight alerts were checked in one slow batch.
history.fix_summary: Checked alerts on every price tick instead of in a batch.

history.name: Funds added twice on a slow UPI callback
history.symptoms: When the UPI callback was slow and the user retried, the money was credited twice.
history.fix_summary: Credited funds once per UPI transaction ID.

history.name: Average buy price wrong after a stock split

history.name: PAN check rejects lowercase letters

history.fix_summary: Uppercased the PAN before checking it.

history.name: Stop-limit orders rejected near the circuit limit

history.name: Statement sell prices rounded down
history.symptoms: Monthly statements showed sell prices rounded down to the rupee, so realised gains looked smaller.

history.name: Price alerts sent twice
history.symptoms: Some price alerts were sent twice when two servers checked the same alert.
history.fix_summary: Marked alerts as sent with a conditional update.

history.name: Holdings show sold shares until the next day
history.symptoms: Shares sold in the morning still showed in Android holdings until the next day.
history.fix_summary: Refreshed holdings after every executed order.

history.name: Tax report counts early 1 April dividends in the old year
history.symptoms: Dividends credited between midnight and 5:30 AM on 1 April were counted in the previous year's tax report, because the year was cut by UTC date.

history.name: IPO bids lost when the UPI mandate is approved late
history.symptoms: IPO bids whose UPI mandate was approved after 5 PM were silently dropped.
history.fix_summary: Showed the mandate deadline and kept bids until it passed.

history.name: Portfolio value rounded on the widget
history.symptoms: The Android home-screen widget showed portfolio value rounded to the nearest ₹1,000.
history.fix_summary: Showed whole rupees on the widget.

history.name: Price alerts never fire for symbols with a dot

history.name: Bracket orders lose their stop leg after an edit
history.symptoms: Editing the target price of a bracket order silently removed its stop-loss leg.
history.fix_summary: Kept every leg when changing a bracket order.

history.name: Withdrawals fail on bank holidays
history.symptoms: Withdrawals requested on bank holidays failed instead of waiting for the next working day.
history.fix_summary: Queued withdrawals made on holidays.

history.name: Watchlist order mixed up after editing on two devices
history.symptoms: Reordering a watchlist on the phone and the web at the same time left a mixed-up order.
history.fix_summary: Saved the order with a version number and rejected stale writes.

history.name: Tax report crashes on delisted stocks
history.symptoms: The tax report failed for anyone who had held a stock that was later delisted, because its current price was null.
history.fix_summary: Used the last traded price for delisted stocks.

history.name: Average buy price wrong after a bonus issue
history.symptoms: After a 1:1 bonus issue, holdings showed twice the shares at the old average price, so the app showed a large loss.
history.fix_summary: Applied the bonus ratio to both quantity and average price in CorporateActions.apply_bonus().

history.name: 1-minute chart skips the 9:15 candle
history.symptoms: The 1-minute chart left out the 9:15 candle, because candles started at the first full minute after the open.
history.fix_summary: Included the opening minute's candle.

history.name: Watchlist keeps delisted stocks
history.symptoms: Delisted stocks stayed in watchlists with a frozen price.
history.fix_summary: Removed delisted stocks nightly and told the user.

history.name: Order-fill notifications missing on iOS
history.symptoms: Order-fill notifications stopped arriving on iPhones after the push certificate was renewed.
history.fix_summary: Installed the new push certificate and added an expiry alert.

history.name: IPO allotment status a day late
history.symptoms: The app showed 'allotment pending' for a day after the registrar published results.
history.fix_summary: Checked the registrar every 15 minutes on allotment day.

history.name: Market depth shows filled bids
history.symptoms: The market depth panel on the web kept showing bids for up to 5 seconds after they were filled.
history.fix_summary: Streamed depth updates instead of polling.

new_report.title: Stop-loss orders executed twice at the open, and grey logos
new_report.description: On Tuesday, 37 customers had stop-loss orders executed twice during the 9:15 spike. history.name: Tamil subtitles garbled on the web player
history.symptoms: Tamil subtitles showed as boxes on the web player, because the subtitle file was read as Latin-1.
history.fix_summary: Read subtitle files as UTF-8.

history.name: Profile pictures don't update
history.symptoms: New profile pictures didn't show for up to a week, because the CDN cached them under the same URL.
history.fix_summary: Versioned profile picture URLs.

history.name: Subtitles slowly drift out of sync on long films
history.symptoms: On every device, subtitles fell steadily behind on films mastered at 25 fps, about 2½ minutes an hour, because the subtitle converter assumed 24 fps.
history.fix_summary: Read the frame rate from the stream manifest in subtitles/vtt_convert.go before converting timestamps.

history.name: Charged twice when switching plans
history.symptoms: Switching plans twice quickly charged the card for both plans.
history.fix_summary: Locked the subscription while a plan change is in progress.

history.name: Downloads stuck at 99% on Android
history.symptoms: Downloads stopped at 99%, because the last segment was never marked done.
history.fix_summary: Marked the final segment done when its last byte arrives.

history.name: Kids profiles show 16+ titles in search
history.symptoms: Searching from a kids profile showed 16+ titles, because the search index ignored the profile's rating limit.
history.fix_summary: Applied the profile's rating limit in search/filter.go.

history.name: TV home-screen previews play with sound
history.symptoms: Previews on the Android TV home screen played with sound despite the 'muted previews' setting.
history.fix_summary: Read the setting before starting previews.

history.name: Live channels fail with 'link expired' at 5:30 AM
history.symptoms: Live channels stopped with 'link expired' at 5:30 AM every morning, because live tokens expired at the end of the UTC day.
history.fix_summary: Issued live tokens with a rolling 6-hour expiry in LiveToken.Issue().

history.name: Second subtitle track missing from the menu
history.symptoms: Titles with two subtitle tracks only showed the first one in the menu.
history.fix_summary: Listed every track from the manifest.

history.name: Continue watching shows finished episodes
history.symptoms: Finished episodes stayed in Continue watching for hours, because progress was cached per profile.
history.fix_summary: Cleared the progress cache when an episode finishes.

history.name: Recommendations repeat the title you just finished
history.symptoms: The 'Because you watched' row often started with the title the viewer had just finished.
history.fix_summary: Left watched titles out of the row.

history.name: Subtitles drift out of sync on Android TV
history.symptoms: On Android TV, subtitles fell behind after the viewer paused for more than a minute, because the player restarted the subtitle clock from the pause position.
history.fix_summary: Drove subtitles from the video's own clock in SubtitleRenderer.kt.

history.name: Downloads fail with 'link expired' when the phone's clock is wrong
history.symptoms: Downloads failed with 'link expired' on phones whose clock was more than 5 minutes off, because signed URLs were checked against the device clock.
history.fix_summary: Signed every playback and download URL with the server's time in SignURL() in cdn/sign.go.

history.name: Renewal charged a day early for users in the US
history.symptoms: Monthly renewals were charged a day early for users in the US, because the renewal date was worked out at midnight UTC.
history.fix_summary: Worked out renewal dates in the user's timezone.

history.name: Android TV player freezes on 4K HDR titles
history.symptoms: 4K HDR titles froze after about 20 minutes on TVs with 2 GB of memory, because decoded frames were never released.
history.fix_summary: Released frames after rendering.

history.name: Kids profiles can play 16+ titles from a shared link
history.symptoms: Opening a shared link to a 16+ title from a kids profile played it without asking for the PIN.
history.fix_summary: Checked the rating limit before playback starts.

history.name: Plans page shows old prices after a change
history.symptoms: After a price change, the plans page showed the old prices for up to an hour.
history.fix_summary: Purged the plans page cache on price changes.

history.name: iOS player loses audio after a phone call
history.symptoms: After a phone call, playback resumed without audio.
history.fix_summary: Reactivated the audio session after interruptions.

history.name: Search can't find titles with an apostrophe
history.symptoms: Searching for titles with an apostrophe, like 'Raja's Return', found nothing.
history.fix_summary: Escaped apostrophes in search queries.

history.name: Old parental PIN works on TVs after a change
history.symptoms: The old parental PIN kept working on TVs for up to a day after it was changed.
history.fix_summary: Checked the PIN with the server instead of a cached copy.

history.name: Renamed episodes keep their old titles in the app
history.symptoms: After a studio renamed episodes, the app showed the old titles for a week, because catalog entries were cached.
history.fix_summary: Purged the catalog cache when a title's details change.

history.name: Renewed downloads deleted after 30 days anyway
history.symptoms: On iOS, renewed downloads were still deleted 30 days after the first download.
history.fix_summary: Updated the expiry date when a download is renewed.

history.name: GST added twice on annual plans
history.symptoms: Annual plans added GST twice: on the plan price and again on the total.
history.fix_summary: Applied GST once, on the plan price.

history.name: Recommendation rows titled in the wrong language
history.symptoms: Viewers who chose Hindi got recommendation rows titled in English.
history.fix_summary: Used the profile language for row titles.

history.name: Web player crashes on Safari when skipping the intro
history.symptoms: Clicking 'Skip intro' on Safari crashed the web player.
history.fix_summary: Seeked with a Safari-safe call.

history.name: Downloads count twice toward the device limit
history.symptoms: Downloading on two phones at once counted each phone twice toward the 5-device limit.
history.fix_summary: Counted devices once per device ID.

history.name: Autoplay skips an episode on the web
history.symptoms: Autoplay jumped from episode 3 to episode 5 on the web.
history.fix_summary: Picked the next episode by number, not by list position.

history.name: Basic plan allows two streams at once
history.symptoms: Basic-plan accounts could stream on two TVs at once, because the stream count was checked before the first stream registered.
history.fix_summary: Registered each stream before checking the plan's limit.

new_report.title: Subtitles drifting out of sync again on Android TV
new_report.description: Viewers on Android TV say subtitles fall behind on some films, and the Android TV team thinks it's the pause problem. Our test on 'The Long Monsoon', mastered at 25 fps: after two hours of playback without a single pause, subtitles are about 5 minutes behind, and the web player is behind by the same amount. Films mastered at 24 fps are fine on every device.

key_clue: after two hours of playback without a single pause, subtitles are about 5 minutes behind, and the web player is behind by the same amount
why: A steady drift on 25 fps films, with no pause and on the web too, is #3508 (the shared converter assuming 24 fps); #3539 drifted only on Android TV after a pause, so the Android TV team's guess is wrong.
